Hi! Let us solve this together. 

Look at the bottom numbers. We have 3 and 6. 

How do we get from 3 to 6? What do we multiply by?
multiply by two? i think answer is 2/6.

Good job! You multiply by two. 

Wait. Whatever you do to the bottom number, you must do to the top number too. 

Can you multiply the top number, 2, by 2? What do you get?

Yes! You got 4/6. Great work. 

Now we have a new sum. It is 2/9 plus 4/9. 

Look at the bottom numbers. Are they the same?
I do not understand. Why you add top and bottom stay same?

Think of a pizza. Cut into 9 slices. 

The bottom number tells you the size of the slice. It stays as 9. 

You have 2 slices. You add 4 more slices. 

How many slices do you have in total on the top?
is it 6/18? i add 9 and 9 on bottom.

Good guess, but the bottom number stays the same. We do not add the 9s. 

It is just like counting pizza slices. 

If you have 2 slices and add 4 slices, how many slices do you have? 

And the bottom number stays as 9. What is the top number?
Top number is 6. Answer is 6/9 because two plus four is six and bottom stay nine. next: 1/4 + 1/8?

Yes! You got 6/9. Well done. 

Now we have 1/4 plus 1/8.
